title: Constructive families and an extension theorem for binary permutation X-rays
abstract: We prove permutation realization for every admissible binary X-ray profile whose rank deviations from the odd staircase lie in [-2, 2], at every order and without a bound on density slack. We also prove the one-sided families with all deviations at least -1 or all deviations at most 1, with at least 2^u realizations, where u counts positive or negative deviations respectively. For n >= 1, if a label multiset L is realizable at order n, then Q(L) = {3, 2n+1} multiset-union (L+2) is realizable at order n+2. If every source label lies in [2, 2n-2], then h(L) <= h(Q(L)), where h counts permutation realizations. Repeated source labels are allowed. A least-order counterexample to the unrestricted conjecture must have first deviation at least 3 or last deviation at most -3. The unrestricted conjecture remains open.
